evals.prompt: Nghiên cứu Redis 7.2 cho workload cache 100k GET/s, value 1KB, 1 node. Giải thích vì sao nó nhanh, so sánh với Memcached và Hazelcast. Ghi ra file markdown.
evals.expected_output: A note that traces one GET from the client through the event loop, epoll, socket copies and RESP framing, with mermaid diagrams and an architecture comparison table.
expectations: Has a component map with IDs (C1, C2, …) and a mermaid flowchart
Covers the OS/kernel layer with the I/O model (epoll) and syscalls/copies per request
Covers the network layer (RESP framing, round-trips, pipelining)
Each alternative has its own architecture diagram for the same operation
Comparison cells state mechanisms and costs, not adjectives
Claims about internals link to source code or official docs with a version
States a breaking point: a workload where Redis stops being fast and why

evals.prompt: Kafka vs RabbitMQ cho log event 500k msg/s, giữ 7 ngày: vì sao Kafka chịu được thông lượng đó? Đi xuống tới kernel.
evals.expected_output: Append-only log, page cache, sendfile zero-copy, batching, partition parallelism vs RabbitMQ queue/ack model, all layer by layer.
expectations: Explains sequential append + page cache and zero-copy sendfile at the kernel layer
Explains batching and partitioning with counted costs
RabbitMQ is traced through the same operation with its own diagram
Verdict is phrased as conditions (choose X when …)

evals.prompt: Tìm hiểu bản chất Nginx làm reverse proxy cho 50k kết nối đồng thời, so sánh kiến trúc với Apache httpd (prefork/event).
evals.expected_output: Master/worker + event loop per worker vs process/thread per connection, with memory and context-switch costs per connection.
expectations: Shows the per-worker event loop (epoll) vs Apache's process/thread model with diagrams
Counts memory and context switches per connection for both
Gives observe commands (e.g. strace, ss, perf) for the mechanism
